CustomField.description: How long the run took, or how long it has been going if it has not finished. A Completed, Failed or Aborted run that stored no duration shows the time between its start and its end.
CustomField.formula: IF ( NOT(ISBLANK(DurationMs__c)), DurationMs__c, IF ( AND ( NOT(ISBLANK(StartedAt__c)), ISBLANK(CompletedAt__c), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Running"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Stalled") ) ), ROUND((NOW() - StartedAt__c) * 86400000, 0), IF ( AND ( NOT(ISBLANK(StartedAt__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(CompletedAt__c)), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Failed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Aborted") ) ), ROUND((CompletedAt__c - StartedAt__c) * 86400000, 0), null ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How long the run took in milliseconds, or how long it has been going so far. A Completed, Failed or Aborted run that stored no duration shows the time between its start and its end.
CustomField.label: Elapsed (ms)
